In 2003, Luton Town were in crisis. New chairman John Gurney was the face of a mystery consortium that turned fans against their own club. Luton Town fans rose up against their own chairman - forging a maverick plot to buy the club's debt and put their own club into administration - to oust the chairman and change the club's future. babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail discovers a nest on a porch! Join him as he sees a little chick hatch from its egg!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail explores grass in a garden! Join him as he meets a grasshopper! Discover how his green colour helps him hide from lizards!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Little Cabin in the Woods is a popular and fun song that teaches toddlers and young children colors and shapes with yummy fruits.

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: On your marks, get set, go! Harley and Perry are off on a race in their rubber duck boats. Harley is out to win and isn't playing fair.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix and Leo go to a lot of trouble trying to get a bunch of grapes hanging from a tall tree. Mama bird also has her eyes on the grapes.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli has a tough time falling asleep with all the noises he hears in the jungle. He decides to sing to himself which helps him calm down.

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: An umbrella arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that an umbrella is used for flying in the wind... is it?...

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A tambourine arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Using her detective skill and her best friend Roy, Zeina discovers that a tambourine is used for jumping... is it? S1 Ep3

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Come ride through the town with your favorite BabyTV characters - Baby Butterfly, Elephant, Giraffe, Sheep, Rabit and Squirrel.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Tommy is tired of always being last. Everyone always has to wait for him because he's the slowest. Can Mike think of something that can help Tommy?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Petite is dressed up as a cute little mouse and she wants her bike to be dressed up, too. Will Mikey have a costume for her bike?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bike
babytv.uk.description: Johnny and Hal want to ride together, but they can't... Johnny rides too fast, and Hal rides too slowly.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a shovel and a sieve! Help Mona dig in the ground and discover an ancient treasure! S1 Ep3

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join the fun as Sketch scribbles wooden planks and tools! Step into the workshop and build a table and chair! S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? A chair to sit on while eating a tasty meal!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam Bam have fun playing with the little doll house and doll family they received as a present. S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: When the kites get stuck, they are left with the strings and find imaginative ways to play with them and wag their new "tails"!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel is sleeping soundly when the ferry Ki takes him on a magical journey in the sky. Join them as they float through the stars and the moon.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe and Baby want to sing the friendship song together. Pretty soon the entire bunch are singing and playing to the catchy tune. S1 Ep8

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Baby wants to play with his friends but they are all busy. Squirrel is working in his garden, Giraffe is cleaning her roof.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Elephant and Baby have come over to Rabbit's house to have some of his delicious carrot cake. S1 Ep10

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ellie looks for the ball in the water and sees another elephant copying his movements! Ducky and Froggy see a duck and frog in the water too!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Come have fun with bubbles in the tub! Froggy has a bubble head, Ellie gets a bubble beard and Ducky looks like a sheep!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ellie and Froggy are planning a surprise birthday party for Ducky! Help hang balloons and decorate the cake!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends play with a pot and a spoon! The pot flips over and turns into a drum!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends have fun sweeping with a broom! Come along as the broom turns into a happy horse!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The friends play with chairs that turn into train seats! Join the ride! The train gets stuck on a mountain!

babytv.uk.title: Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Uh Oh gets stuck on the roof while cleaning the window. The friends try to help but get stuck as well.

babytv.uk.title: Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Dodo's art exhibition is on. His friends pick out beautiful paintings as a presents and Dodo misses his art paintings. S1 Ep15

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Lobster
cinemax.us.description: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. (Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: The Apparition
cinemax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Trance
cinemax.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Rover
cinemax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
cinemax.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (Music, Documentary) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Buffaloed
cinemax.us.description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector. (Comedy) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Judge
cinemax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (Drama) - 2014

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (movie) - 1981

cinemaxaction.us.title: It
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (movie) - 1990

cinemaxaction.us.title: Life of Pi
cinemaxaction.us.description: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxaction.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemaxaction.us.description: Renowned ballroom dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a job at a New York City public school and helps his students meld hip-hop and classical styles to create a dance form. (movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: Room
cinemaxaction.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxaction.us.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
cinemaxaction.us.description: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxaction.us.description: After glimpsing his future, an ambitious politician (Matt Damon) battles the agents of Fate itself to be with the woman (Emily Blunt) he loves. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxaction.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Desperate to reach his pregnant wife (Michelle Monaghan), a high-strung architect (Robert Downey Jr.) takes a road trip home with an annoying stranger (Zach Galifianakis). (movie) - 2010

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (movie) - 1974

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Time-travelers' efforts to prevent a dinosaur's mutation result in the creation of a three-headed dragon that terrorizes Japan. (movie) - 1991

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Night on Earth
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Mississippi Masala
cinemaxclassics.us.description: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (movie) - 1991

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean organizes a gang to steal $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos in a single heist. (movie) - 2001

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxclassics.us.description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe. (movie) - 2004

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. (movie) - 2007

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Rick and Fred, two husbands who are having difficulty in their marriages, are given a Hall Pass by their wives for one week, they can do whatever they want. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Get Him to the Greek
cinemaxclassics.us.description: A record-company employee (Jonah Hill) has just a few days to get a boozy British rock star (Russell Brand) to Hollywood for a big comeback concert. (movie) - 2010

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' (Donald Pleasence) patient to sacrifice an entire family in Haddonfield, Ill. (movie) - 1995

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In hiding for two decades, a traumatized woman (Jamie Lee Curtis) learns her murderous brother has returned for her. (movie) - 1998

cinemaxclassics.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek. (movie) - 2002

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
cinemaxclassics.us.description: With the sitter dead, a Los Angeles teen (Christina Applegate) lands a job in the fashion industry to feed her siblings. (movie) - 1991

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman
cinemaxhits.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (movie) - 1989

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxhits.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (movie) - 1992

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxhits.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (movie) - 1995

cinemaxhits.us.title: Batman & Robin

cinemaxhits.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
cinemaxhits.us.description: Former special-operations mercenary Frank Martin (Ed Skrein) utilizes his covert skills when a femme fatale (Loan Chabanol) uses him as a pawn in her vengeful scheme against the human trafficker (Camille Delamarre) who victimized her years earlier. (movie) - 2015

cinemaxhits.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxhits.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) and his estranged son (Jai Courtney) must put aside their differences and work together to get a Russian whistleblower to safety and thwart a disastrous crime in Chernobyl. (movie) - 2013

cinemaxhits.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemaxhits.us.description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner. (movie) - 2005

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It
gameshowcentral.us.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

The winning pair takes home the money earned in the game and plays the bonus round, where even more cash is up for grabs. Comic Ben Gleib hosts the show that isn't afraid to call its players idiots. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140812

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

gameshowcentral.us.title: Baggage
gameshowcentral.us.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Finese Wedges
golfpass.us.description: Cameron provides instruction to help golfers execute one of golf's most difficult shots - the short wedge shot. He helps you in understanding why contact, speed and dynamic loft will help you play your very best from 40–60 yards.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - PhD Wedge Play
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick shares his very best instruction to help golfers perfect one of golf's most difficult shots - the short wedge shot.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Greenside Vitals
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick teaches how to play those all-important stroke saving shots from around the green which include: set-up fundamentals, swing dynamics, and tour-proven drills.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Greenside Mastery
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick helps golfers understand how they can have the ability to get up and down with tour-level precision; McCormick dials in the greenside wedge play just with three-time major champion Jordan Spieth.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Swiss Army Knife Short Game
golfpass.us.description: Preparing for an assortment of difficult shots around the green with teacher Cameron McCormick.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Sand Mastery
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick brings his instruction into the bunker to help golfers enjoy their trips to the beach.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Putting Triad
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick helps golfers make more putts. Most recreational golfers are missing putts because they do not focus on the putting triad - line, speed, and read.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - PhD Putting
golfpass.us.description: Improving putting by using specific drills and games that allow you to self-detect tendencies in your game and then identify skill improvement opportunities to help you make more putts.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Masters Edition Volume 1
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy answers member-submitted questions about how to swing better, shoot lower scores and have more fun with challenges on the golf course.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Masters Edition Volume 2
golfpass.us.description: Rory McIlroy answers member-submitted questions about how to swing better, shoot lower scores and have more fun with challenges on the golf course.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 6: Slice and Hook Cures
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal show which setup, swing, and equipment adjustments translate into stopping slices and hooks. Martin shares some of his favorite drills on finding the proper grip, maintaining balance, and swinging on the proper plane.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 7: Dial In Your Wedges
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the best wedge tips for around the green. Learn how to set up for success, use tees to improve contact, and how to control distance like Dustin Johnson with the use of a clock.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 8: Lessons From The Masters
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots needed for success in The Masters; Martin shares a driving tip he learned playing golf with Dustin Johnson and a distance drill used by Jack Nicklaus; a top college player gives a guest lesson.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 9: Putting Class
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall explains how to become a better putter ASAP; those four letters standing for aim, stability, arc, and pace. Martin shares drills for each letter from putting gurus including Dave Stockton, Phil Kenyon, and the late Frank Thomas.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 10: The Golden Bear
golfpass.us.description: 18-time Major Champion Jack Nicklaus speaks with Martin Hall about being coached at an early age by Jack Grout, his number one swing fundamental, and how to maximize distance with the driver. Favorite drills inspired by The Golden Bear.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 11: Tempo and Rhythm
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal demonstrate how to improve on tempo and rhythm. Martin discusses the difference between the two and shares tips used by Hall of Famers such as Tom Watson, Ernie Els, Vijay Singh, and Nick Faldo.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 12: U.S. Open
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach the shots needed for success in the U.S. Open. Jack Nicklaus joins for an exclusive interview and shares the ball striking skill that helped him become a 4-time U.S. Open champion.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 24: Year End Special
golfpass.us.description: Find out how to crush the driver like 2021 PGA Championship winner Phil Mickelson, split the fairway under pressure like 2021 Masters champion Hideki Matsuyama, and sink breaking putts like 2021 U.S. Open Champion Jon Rahm.

golfpass.us.title: Nathalie Filler Sheehan: Breaking 100
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie Filler Sheehan shows swing fixes and strategic tips from tee to green that will help drive scores below the century mark in no time.

golfpass.us.title: Martin Hall: Breaking 90 - 90
golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall brings out all the tools and analogies to help fix swing faults and poor strategies that are holding players back from shooting in the 80s.

golfpass.us.title: Martin Chuck: Breaking 80
golfpass.us.description: Martin Chuck is back with another breaking series where he will provide players with all the mental and physical tools they need to start shooting in the 70s consistently.

golfpass.us.title: Devan Bonebrake: Breaking Par - Par
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake helps players break par with drills, strategies and by following Tiger's six metrics to breaking par, which Devan was taught by his mentor Joey Wuertemberger.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Golf's Greatest Myths - Martin Chuck - Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Martin Chuck examines a number of swing myths that have persisted over the years like "keep your head down" and "keep your lead arm straight.".

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Golf's Greatest Myths - Martin Chuck - Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Martin Chuck examines a number of swing myths that have persisted over the years like "keep your head down" and "keep your lead arm straight.".

golfpass.us.title: Breaking into the Game: Beginners - Series Preview
golfpass.us.description: Shot at The Club at Ibis, Martin Hall's new series is the definitive video golf instruction piece for beginners, providing a solid foundation for new golfers of any age.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Your Slice With Nathalie Sheehan - Introduction
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie introduces the contributing factors of a slice and identifies the two types of slicers that exist.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Your Slice With Nathalie Sheehan - Grip & Setup
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie introduces an error that some might be making with a grip to cause a slice; she also explains the differences between a draw setup with a driver and one with the irons.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game: Bunkers - Bunker
golfpass.us.description: Sharing some tools, techniques and drills for any bunker shot.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game: Bunkers - Bunker - Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Sharing tips on good tempo and uneven lies, Martin Hall helps prepare players for sand traps.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Jon Sinclair - Somewhere in Texas
golfpass.us.description: Meet Jon Sinclair, who uses 3-D technology to help golfers of all skill levels better understand the golf swing.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Andrew Getson - Coaching Phil Mickelson
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como and Andrew Getson share a common bond of coaching superstar golfers. Getson reveals what he's learned from his student, Phil Mickelson, as Como compares it to his time with Tiger Woods.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Stan Utley - Putting Guru
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como visits putting and short game expert Stan Utley in Scottsdale, Arizona. Learn how the putter arch should swing and how to minimize putter face rotation. Plus, Utley demonstrates the best tips for pitch and chip shots.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Brandel Chamblee & Lucas Wald
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como spends a day with rising-star coach Lucas Wald and two of his high profile students, Brandel Chamblee, and Eddie Fernandes. Lucas and Brandel demonstrate the adjustments made to Brandel's swing and how modern golf played its part.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Inside PING HQ
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como visits PING Headquarters in Phoenix and learns how PING uses technology to make the game simpler for all golfers. Also, meet the "PING Man" and go inside the labs where PING tests clubs and swings.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Jim McLean - X Factor
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como spends a day with teaching legend Jim McLean for an in-depth look at his popular swing thoughts and his books. McLean also shares memories from his time with Arnold Palmer, Tiger Woods, and Carl Welty.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Central - On-Site
golfpass.us.description: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf. The game's only live, daily news source provides more than just scores, delivering in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Central - On-Site
golfpass.us.description: Keep up with everything that's happening in the world of golf. The game's only live, daily news source provides more than just scores, delivering in depth analysis, breaking news, and unforgettable highlights.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Martin Hall - How the Professor Teaches
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como spends a day with "School of Golf" host Martin Hall in his natural habitat; how to visualize the golf swing; how the club path and face affect the swing; how to achieve an ideal impact position; how to find a safe go-to shot.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Bryson DeChambeau - Mechanics Deep Dive
golfpass.us.description: Multiple-time tour winner Bryson DeChambeau and his coach Chris Como give an inside look of a training session focusing on swing mechanics, the science of golf, and more.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Jeff Leishman - Molding Tour Talent
golfpass.us.description: Chris travels to Jupiter, Florida and learns from Jeff Leishman the importance of the transition and sequence in the swing. Leishman also shares drills that have helped top professionals improve their short game.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Brian Mogg
golfpass.us.description: Brian Mogg shares gadgets that help him demonstrate fundamental concepts.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - A View From the Treetops
golfpass.us.description: Flying in from around the country, the "Big Break" contestants meet for the first time and, within hours, seem like old friends.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Someone's Gotta Go
golfpass.us.description: Famed golf instructor and "The Big Break" co-host Rick Smith meets the contestants and braces them for their first serious day of competition.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Who Will Survive?
golfpass.us.description: Contestants scramble to beat the clock and end up as the golfer with the most points to win the all-important Mulligan.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Up, Up, Up and Over
golfpass.us.description: Contestants try to imitate PGA Tour star Phil Mickelson's talent of shooting the ball virtually straight up in the air, the extreme flop shot.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Pick a Club, Any Club
golfpass.us.description: The skills challenge forces the golfers to choose the shots they believe will deliver the biggest payoff.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The Need for Speed
golfpass.us.description: The six remaining golfers have to show their speed in this team skills challenge, but they can't forget accuracy.

grit.us.title: The Violent Men
grit.us.description: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith). (Western) - 1955

grit.us.title: The Tin Star
grit.us.description: Morgan Hickman is a tough gunslinger with a knack for keeping his cool in tense situations. When he wanders into a town where the local lawman has been killed, he finds callow but eager Ben Owens temporarily acting as sheriff. Soon Ben, who wants to keep his new position, is looking to Morgan for guidance. Though the bounty hunter has his own issues with law enforcement, he admires Ben's enthusiasm and decides to train him to be an effective sheriff. (Western) - 1957

grit.us.title: Joe Kidd
grit.us.description: In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch. (Western) - 1972

grit.us.title: Two Mules for Sister Sara
grit.us.description: When gunslinger Hogan (Clint Eastwood) discovers a group of men attempting to rape a young nun, Sara (Shirley MacLaine), he shoots them dead and rescues the woman. The two escape to a nearby camp of Mexican revolutionaries, who have hired Hogan to help fight the invading French army. En route, Sara turns out to be surprisingly crude for a nun, drinking, smoking and using curse words. When she also proves to be handy with a gun, Hogan begins wondering if she is telling him the whole truth. (Western, Action, Adventure) - 1970

grit.us.title: High Plains Drifter
grit.us.description: In this Western, a drifter with no name wanders into a small town, where his gun-slinging abilities are in high demand. When the drifter rides into Lago, he is met with incredulity and disapproval by the townspeople. But once he shows his skills with a pistol, the locals realize he may be able to help them fend off a band of criminals who have been terrorizing the town. He agrees to help the townspeople, but does so with his own secret agenda. (Western) - 1973

screenpix.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpix.us.title: Diary of a Hitman
screenpix.us.description: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task. (Crime drama) - 1992

screenpix.us.title: Not as a Stranger
screenpix.us.description: Ambitious medical student Lucas Marsh (Robert Mitchum) aspires to being a doctor with his own practice. Unable to fund his studies himself, he woos the warm, supportive nurse Kristina (Olivia de Havilland), who has the financial resources he needs for him to realize his dreams. The couple marries and moves to a small town, where Lucas works as an assistant to Dr. Runkleman (Charles Bickford). However, after a series of betrayals, Lucas is forced to face life without the help of others. (Drama) - 1955

screenpix.us.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, an Italian villager (Gina Lollobrigida) befriends three American soldiers. Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpix.us.title: Violent Playground
screenpix.us.description: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons. (Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: The Fugitive Kind
screenpix.us.description: When drifter Valentine Xavier (Marlon Brando) arrives in a southern town, he catches the eye of the married Lady Torrance (Anna Magnani) and the oversexed alcoholic, Carol Cutrere (Joanne Woodward). Both vie for his attention, with Lady Torrance emerging victorious, offering Xavier employment in her general store, while her cancer-stricken husband is bedridden upstairs. After impregnating Lady Torrance and butting heads with friends of her husband, Xavier must make a crucial decision. (Drama) - 1960

screenpix.us.title: The Malta Story
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, British photo-reconnaissance pilot Peter (Alec Guinness) discovers that the Italians are planning a secret invasion of Malta, a strategically important island nation critical to keeping the Allied supply lines open. Though they have few resources left, Peter and his commanding officer, Frank (Jack Hawkins), resolve to fight off the enemy and save the island. At the same time, Peter struggles to keep his relationship with a local girl from falling apart. (War) - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: Ambush Bay
screenpixaction.us.description: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day. (War) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: Submarine X-1
screenpixaction.us.description: Cmdr. Richard Bolton was in charge of a submarine that was sunk by a German ship, and he has been blamed for the loss of 50 sailors. Now exonerated of misconduct, he is heading a mission to use minisubs to reach a German battleship commanded by Capt. Erlich. During training, Bolton encounters some of his previous crew members, all of whom harbor grudges against him, which further complicates the already dangerous mission. (War) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Tank Battalion
screenpixaction.us.description: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches. (War) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Salt and Pepper
screenpixaction.us.description: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot. (Comedy) - 1968

screenpixaction.us.title: Topkapi
screenpixaction.us.description: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination. screenpixaction.us.title: Cul-de-Sac

screenpixvoices.us.title: Truck Turner

screenpixvoices.us.title: Friday Foster

showtime.us.title: Yellowjackets
showtime.us.description: "Yellowjackets" tells the narrative of a team of wildly talented high-school girls soccer players who survive a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to warring, cannibalistic clans, while also tracking the lives they have attempted to piece back together. Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher and Sammi Hanratty star as the teenagers, while Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci and Juliette Lewis portray their adult counterparts as they reveal the truth about their survival 25 years later. (Drama)

showtime.us.title: Molly's Game
showtime.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography)

showtime.us.title: True Grit
showtime.us.description: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. (Western)

showtime.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtime.us.description: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo. (Adventure)

showtime.us.title: Rush Hour
showtime.us.description: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police. (Action)

showtime2west.us.title: Twister
showtime2west.us.description: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
showtime2west.us.description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

showtime2west.us.title: Troy
showtime2west.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

showtime2west.us.title: 48 HRS.
showtime2west.us.description: A rumpled detective gets a slick convict released into his custody for two days to help him find a murderer in San Francisco.

showtime2west.us.title: Another 48 Hrs.
showtime2west.us.description: Jack Cates once again enlists the aid of ex-con Reggie Hammond. This time it is to take down The Iceman, a ruthless drug lord operating in the San Francisco Bay Area.

showtime2west.us.title: Rush Hour
showtime2west.us.description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

showtime2west.us.title: Rush Hour 2
showtime2west.us.description: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy.

showtime2west.us.title: Rush Hour 3
showtime2west.us.description: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtime2west.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtime2west.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtime2west.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

showtimeextreme.us.title: Hamburger Hill
showtimeextreme.us.description: Over the course of 10 days in May 1969, an infantry squad led by Lt. Frantz (Dylan McDermott) and composed of both seasoned troops and new recruits, attempts to take a hill during the Vietnam War. In between attacks, the squad members deal with the other psychological stresses of the war, including the effect on morale of the antiwar movement back home and flashes of racial hostility between white and African-American soldiers, all mediated by the cool-headed medic, Doc (Courtney B. Vance). (War, Historical drama, Action, Thriller, Docudrama) - 1987

showtimeextreme.us.title: Dunkirk
showtimeextreme.us.description: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. (War, Historical drama, Action) - 2017

showtimeextreme.us.title: Argo
showtimeextreme.us.description: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography) - 2012

showtimeextreme.us.title: Ballistic
showtimeextreme.us.description: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2024

showtimeextreme.us.title: Saving Private Ryan
showtimeextreme.us.description: Captain John Miller (Tom Hanks) takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Surrounded by the brutal realties of war, while searching for Ryan, each man embarks upon a personal journey and discovers their own strength to triumph over an uncertain future with honor, decency and courage. (War, Historical drama) - 1998

showtimeextreme.us.title: Behind Enemy Lines
showtimeextreme.us.description: A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission. (Action, War, Thriller, Drama, Adventure) - 2001

showtimeextreme.us.title: The Hunt for Red October
showtimeextreme.us.description: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. (Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 1990

showtimeextreme.us.title: Homestead
showtimeextreme.us.description: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. (Thriller, Drama) - 2024

showtimeextreme.us.title: Kingpin
showtimeextreme.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (Comedy) - 1996

showtimeextreme.us.title: Changeland
showtimeextreme.us.description: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis. (Comedy drama) - 2019

showtimeextreme.us.title: Winchester
showtimeextreme.us.description: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy) - 2018

showtimefamily.us.title: Galaxy Quest
showtimefamily.us.description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
showtimefamily.us.description: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the Enterprise crew battle an old foe (Ricardo Montalban) who blames Kirk for the death of his wife.

showtimefamily.us.title: Free Birds

showtimefamily.us.title: Rango
showtimefamily.us.description: In the grip of an identity crisis, a sheltered chameleon accidentally winds up as the sheriff of a frontier town.

showtimefamily.us.title: Sonic the Hedgehog

showtimefamily.us.title: Monster Summer

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
showtimefamily.us.description: Adm. Kirk (William Shatner), Mr. Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Dr. McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and crew embark in the overhauled Enterprise to find an intelligent entity called VGER.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
showtimefamily.us.description: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

showtimefamily.us.description: The release of Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird's groundbreaking comic in 1984 leads to a worldwide phenomenon.

showtimefamily.us.title: A Boy Named Charlie Brown
showtimefamily.us.description: Charlie Brown wins a slot in the national spelling bee in the "Peanuts" gang's first big-screen adventure.

showtimefamily.us.title: Race for Your Life, Charlie Brown!
showtimefamily.us.description: A thrilling raft race highlights the Peanuts gang's summer camp fun.

showtimenext.us.title: The Wedding Banquet
showtimenext.us.description: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet. (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: We're the Millers
showtimenext.us.description: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. (Comedy, Action, Crime drama) - 2013

showtimenext.us.title: Dinner for Schmucks
showtimenext.us.description: Tim (Paul Rudd) a rising executive, works for a boss who hosts a monthly event in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career boost. Though he declines the invitation at first, he changes his mind when he meets Barry (Steve Carell), a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. The scheme backfires when Barry's blundering good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's romantic relationship. (Comedy, Adventure, Action, Drama) - 2010

showtimenext.us.title: Daniela Forever
showtimenext.us.description: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams. (Science fiction, Romance) - 2024

showtimenext.us.title: The Layover
showtimenext.us.description: Best friends Kate and Meg find themselves competing for the same man while waiting for their plane to take off from St. Louis. (Comedy) - 2017

showtimenext.us.title: Scream 3
showtimenext.us.description: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer. (Horror, Comedy, Mystery) - 2000

showtimenext.us.title: Scream 4
showtimenext.us.description: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger. (Horror, Comedy) - 2011

showtimenext.us.title: Office Christmas Party
showtimenext.us.description: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2016

showtimenext.us.title: Marshmallow
showtimenext.us.description: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp. (Horror, Thriller) - 2025

showtimenext.us.title: Run & Gun
showtimenext.us.description: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

showtimenext.us.title: Outside Providence
showtimenext.us.description: In this coming-of-age comedy, Tim Dunphy (Shawn Hatosy) is leading a go-nowhere existence, spending his days smoking pot and hanging out with his best friend, Drugs Delaney (Jon Abrahams). But Tim's lazy days of getting high are jettisoned after a brush with the law convinces his blue-collar dad (Alec Baldwin) to send him to a Connecticut prep school. The one saving grace of the new school is Jane (Amy Smart), a fellow student Tim falls for immediately. (Comedy drama) - 1999

showtimenext.us.title: Tommy Boy
showtimenext.us.description: After his beloved father (Brian Dennehy) dies, dim-witted Tommy Callahan (Chris Farley) inherits a near-bankrupt automobile parts factory in Sandusky, Ohio. His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
showtimeshowcase.us.description: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) is doing hard time in jail when his former boss, Col. Trautman (Richard Crenna), offers him a deal. If Rambo travels to Vietnam to try to find the American prisoners of war, his criminal record will be expunged. Rambo takes the reconnaissance assignment and agrees not to get involved in any of the action. However, when his Vietnamese lover, Co Bao (Julia Nickson), is killed by American forces, Rambo forgets his promise and takes matters into his own hands. (Action, Adventure) - 1985

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When Earth falls under attack from invincible aliens, no military unit in the world is able to beat them. Maj. William Cage (Tom Cruise), an officer who has never seen combat, is assigned to a suicide mission. Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Godfather
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. (Crime drama) - 1972

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Godfather Part II
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. (Crime drama) - 1974

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
showtimeshowcase.us.description: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola). (Crime drama) - 1990

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Shutter Island
showtimeshowcase.us.description: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2010

showtimeshowcase.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries. (Drama) - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Caine Mutiny Court-Martial
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Skeptical lawyer Barney Greenwald (Eric Bogosian) grudgingly defends Lt. Steve Maryk (Jeff Daniels), a navy man who wrestled control of a ship from its domineering captain, Lt. Cmdr. Philip Francis Queeg (Brad Davis), in the midst of a violent storm at sea. As the court-martial progresses, Greenwald begins to wonder if the events aboard the U.S.S. Caine were truly a mutiny, or merely the brave acts of a faithful group of sailors who could no longer trust their unstable leader. (Drama) - 1988

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Alone in Berlin
showtimeshowcase.us.description: A German couple lose their son in WWII, prompting them to become secretly anti-Nazi. (Historical drama) - 2016

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtimeshowcase.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil. (Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: The Mexican
showtimewomen.us.description: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border. (Comedy drama, Adventure, Romance) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Shakespeare in Love
showtimewomen.us.description: "Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays. (Romantic comedy) - 1998

showtimewomen.us.title: Everybody's Fine
showtimewomen.us.description: Eight months after the death of his wife, Frank Goode looks forward to a reunion with his four adult children. When all of them cancel their visits at the last minute, Frank, against the advice of his doctor, sets out on a road trip to reconnect with his offspring. As he visits each one in turn, Frank finds that his children's lives are not quite as picture-perfect as they've made them out to be. (Comedy drama) - 2009

showtimewomen.us.title: You Can Count on Me
showtimewomen.us.description: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt. (Drama) - 2000

showtimewomen.us.title: The Guilt Trip
showtimewomen.us.description: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs. (Comedy, Drama) - 2012

showtimewomen.us.title: Terms of Endearment
showtimewomen.us.description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children. (Comedy drama) - 1983

showtimewomen.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
showtimewomen.us.description: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

showtimewomen.us.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
showtimewomen.us.description: Based on Truman Capote's novel, this is the story of a young woman in New York City who meets a young man when he moves into her apartment building. He is with an older woman who is very wealthy, but he wants to be a writer. She is working as an expensive escort and searching for a rich, older man to marry. (Romantic comedy, Romance, Comedy) - 1961

showtimewomen.us.title: Falling in Love
showtimewomen.us.description: Commuting to Manhattan on the same train, two married strangers (Robert De Niro, Meryl Streep) meet by accident and have an affair. (Romance) - 1984

showtimewomen.us.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
showtimewomen.us.description: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician. (Comedy) - 2021

showtimewomen.us.title: The Firm
showtimewomen.us.description: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1993

showtimewomen.us.title: Red Eye
showtimewomen.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father. (Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Manchurian Candidate
shoxbetwest.us.description: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return. (Thriller, Drama, Mystery, Science fiction) - 2004

shoxbetwest.us.title: Ghost
shoxbetwest.us.description: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons. (Fantasy, Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1990

shoxbetwest.us.title: Sleepless
shoxbetwest.us.description: Undercover Las Vegas police officer Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) finds himself caught in a high-stakes web of corrupt cops, internal affairs and murderous gangsters. When a failed heist leads to the kidnapping of his teenage son (Octavius J. Johnson), Downs must race against time during a wild and restless night to save him and bring the criminals to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Comeback Trail
shoxbetwest.us.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. (Comedy) - 2020

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Heart Specialist
shoxbetwest.us.description: After following a former girlfriend to Florida, Ray Howard (Brian J. White) winds up as an intern in a not-so-prestigious teaching hospital. An unapologetic Lothario, Ray tries to work his charms on nurse Donna (Zoe Saldana), but she's already involved with the chief resident, Dr. Sidney Zachary (Wood Harris), who is also Ray's instructor. Sidney, who moonlights as a standup comic, decides that Ray needs to learn about true love, as well as medicine. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

shoxbetwest.us.title: Fist Fight
shoxbetwest.us.description: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

shoxbetwest.us.title: Norbit
shoxbetwest.us.description: Mild-mannered Norbit (Eddie Murphy) has always had it rough, since the day he was left abandoned at a combination Chinese restaurant and orphanage. Recently forced to marry the shrewish glutton Rasputia, he is at wit's end. Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love. (Comedy, Romance) - 2007

shoxbetwest.us.title: Good Burger

starz.us.description: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

starz.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

starzcinema.us.title: I'm Not There
starzcinema.us.description: Several actors portray legendary singer-songwriter Bob Dylan at different stages in his personal life and career. In 1959 a guitar-strumming youth (Marcus Carl Franklin) rides the rails, calling himself "Guthrie." Then a man named Jack (Christian Bale) emerges in New York's Greenwich Village, followed by "Robbie (Heath Ledger)," Jude (Cate Blanchett) and other personalities. (Biography, Drama) - 2007

starzcinema.us.title: Nemesis Game
starzcinema.us.description: Traumatized by her mother's death in a car crash, college student Sara (Carly Pope) participates in a riddle game, scouring Toronto for spray-painted questions and discussing the puzzles with comic book store owner Vern (Adrian Paul). When Sara and Vern receive separate invitations to participate in a higher-stakes version of the game, they are thrilled. But after Sara's friend Jeremy (Jay Baruchel) is killed, she suspects a dangerous connection between his death and her puzzle-solving. (Thriller) - 2003

starzcinema.us.title: Love, Brooklyn
starzcinema.us.description: Three longtime Brooklynites navigate love, friendship and careers amid the rapidly changing landscape of their beloved city. (Romance) - 2025

starzcinema.us.title: A Girl Like Grace
starzcinema.us.description: Seventeen-year-old Grace (Ryan Destiny) has been raised by her single mother (Garcelle Beauvais), Lisa, in a rather dysfunctional environment. As she yearns for acceptance in the world, Grace finds herself bullied at school by Mary (Raven-Symoné). She seeks guidance from her best friend Andrea (Paige Hurd) and Share, Andrea's older sister. (Drama) - 2015

starzcinema.us.title: The Vow
starzcinema.us.description: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiancé. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage. (Romance, Drama) - 2012
